title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: We are looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer for a short-term engagement involving infrastructure administration, access management and security-related tasks across our cloud environment. Strong AWS, IAM and production infrastructure experience required. Remote, fixed-price project. Please provide your availability and hourly rate.
